criteria.basis: Human-reviewed source-fidelity correction pack, not independent certification of current law/product behavior; exact pack content and metadata plus Local_Apply mappings and Build_Readback successorChecks.
criteria.PASS: Expected successor draft/projection is actually returned; response supplies all question-specific facts below with attributable source URL and correct publication/update dates, respects historical/proposed/conditional scope, and contains neither predecessor-derived misleading claims nor unrelated ERP schema material. A retrieval excerpt can pass only if it supplies those facts; generic validity warnings do not replace missing facts.
criteria.PARTIAL: Relevant corrected source or useful relevant evidence is returned but facts, citation date, explicit requested distinction or negative conclusion are incomplete. No material contradictory claim.
criteria.MISS: No useful answer to the requested facts, unrelated results only, material contradiction, or historical/project/suggestion elevated into confirmed current fact.
criteria.coverage: Separately count exact returned successor draft IDs and exact corrected semantic projection IDs. Source URL alone does not prove new-version coverage. Do not count expected IDs appearing only in request/criteria.
criteria.schema: Inspect returned answer and evidence for unrelated ComarchOptimaSchema/CDN catalog/FK/schema fragments; ordinary JPK XML structure names are not contamination.
criteria.dates: Source publication/update dates are distinct from draft creation, promotion, retrieval and test UTC timestamps. as_of in the wrapper is not effective-date filtering or validity certification.
criteria.initialQueries: One primary query per question; no rewrites substituted for failures. Refinements, if any, are separate and excluded from counts.
criteria.sideEffects: Before live answer calls, use exported pure classification/gatherEvidence/shouldUseExternalFallback to gate against external fallback; reject any predicted fallback and report channel limitation. Ordinary query logging by service is allowed. No editorial/live-source tools.
